items.title: 69537_Jimmy Jones oral history interview
items.q: Hank Jones and I have recorded you

ctx.x: Yeah, it was a good show. I thought it was, and I was happy to be associated with it. And Duke and I began to -- oh, I remember, because Harry had wanted me to -- I had to be an ambassador for Belafonte. He says, "With everybody that I'm getting on this show you've written for." Joe Williams, Gloria Lynn, Duke Ellington. And I went to see Duke, he was recording once out in Long Island, New York, you know, and I spoke to him and I said that -- about this television show, you know. So we pre-recorded it, and we had…
already." So they just -- the cameras just caught him from the chest up. They never showed his hands, because we were playing.
